title: Speed of Light in Vacuum (c)
answer: The speed of light in vacuum is exactly 299,792,458 metres per second (approximately 3 * 10^8 m/s or 186,282 miles per second). Denoted by the physical constant 'c'.
highlights: Significance: Universal physical constant and upper limit for speed of energy, matter, and information

title: Value of Pi (π)
answer: The value of Pi (π) is approximately 3.14159265359... (commonly represented as 22/7 or 3.14). It is defined as the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
highlights: Mathematical Nature: Irrational and transcendental number

title: Standard Acceleration Due to Gravity (g)
answer: The standard acceleration due to Earth gravity at sea level is approximately 9.80665 m/s² (commonly rounded to 9.8 m/s² or 32.174 ft/s²).

title: Photosynthesis — Biological Process & Chemical Equation
answer: Photosynthesis is the biological process by which green plants, algae, and cyanobacteria convert light energy, water (H2O), and carbon dioxide (CO2) into chemical energy (glucose) and oxygen (O2).
highlights: Organelle: Chloroplasts containing green pigment Chlorophyll
Phases: Light-dependent reactions and Light-independent Calvin Cycle

title: Water (H2O) — Chemical Formula & Properties
answer: The chemical formula of water is H2O (two hydrogen atoms bonded covalently to one oxygen atom). Its chemical name is Dihydrogen Monoxide.
highlights: Boiling Point: 100 C (212 F / 373.15 K) at standard 1 atm pressure
Universal Solvent: Dissolves more substances than any other liquid
